en_title: Razer Announces Xbox 25th Anniversary Collection of Peripherals for Xbox Series X|S and PC
cn_title: 雷蛇推出XBOX25周年限定外设
subtitle: 半透明绿回归
opus_summary: 雷蛇推出XBOX25周年限量外设，人体工学鼠标、机械键盘和无线耳塞现已开售。三款均采用半透明绿色，呼应初代主机特别版与调试机配色，但系列中没有XBOX手柄。

paragraphs.en: Gaming peripheral maker Razer has announced a trio of products to mark Xbox's 25th anniversary this Fall. The Xbox 25th Anniversary limited-edition collection consists of three translucent-green versions of flagship Razer products: an ergonomic mouse, a mechanical keyboard, and wireless earbuds. All three are available now.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏外设厂商雷蛇公布了三款产品，庆祝XBOX在今年秋季迎来25周年。这套XBOX25周年限量系列为雷蛇的三款旗舰产品换上了半透明绿色外观，分别是人体工学鼠标、机械键盘和无线耳塞。目前三款产品均已开售。

paragraphs.en: The lineup, which, funnily enough, doesn't include an Xbox gamepad, nevertheless harkens back to the translucent emerald green color seen in a special-edition original-Xbox console and the original-Xbox "debug kits" that us media folks used to play in-development game builds. paragraphs.cn: 有趣的是，这个系列里居然没有XBOX手柄。不过，这套外设的半透明祖母绿配色，仍让人想起初代XBOX特别版主机，以及我们这些媒体人当年用来试玩开发中游戏的初代XBOX「调试机」。以下是雷蛇提供的各款产品介绍：

paragraphs.en: Microsoft itself is celebrating the Xbox's 25th anniversary with translucent green hardware of its own: a special-edition Xbox Series X console (that comes bundled with the perfectly good Halo: Campaign Evolved) and a matching controller . The actual anniversary arrives next month on November 15.
paragraphs.cn: 微软也推出了自己的半透明绿色硬件，庆祝XBOX25周年：一款特别版XBOX Series X主机，以及配套手柄。主机捆绑附赠了相当不错的《光环：战役进化》。XBOX25周年的正日子是下个月的11月15日。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN预览内容执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目Podcast Unlocked的主持人，也是Next-Gen Console Watch的联合主持人。他来自新泽西州北部，所以他管那种肉制品叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。你可以在X上找@DMC_Ryan，和他争论这个问题。
